name: Dr. Joseph S. Mayunga
biography: Dr. Joseph S. Mayunga is a specialist in Disaster Risk Management (DRM), Climate change, geospatial science, and Earth observation. He holds a Ph.D. in Urban and Regional Sciences, specializing in Disaster Risk Management, from Texas A&M University, United States, and a Master of Science (MSc) in Geo-Information Science and Earth Observation from the International Institute for Geo-Information Science and Earth Observation (ITC), the Netherlands.

His research interests include disaster risk management, climate change adaptation and mitigation, and the application of geospatial science, remote sensing, and Earth observation technologies to disaster risk reduction and climate resilience. He has over 20 years of research and professional experience in disaster risk management, climate change, and geospatial science and technology.

Throughout his career, Dr. Mayunga has contributed to numerous research, training, and consultancy assignments related to disaster risk management, climate change, and the application of geospatial technologies in Tanzania and internationally. His work focuses on leveraging scientific knowledge and geospatial technologies to support evidence-based decision-making, disaster risk reduction, and climate resilience.

name: Ms. Vivaoliva U. Shoo
biography: Ms. Shoo is a disaster risk management specialist with over 15 years of experience in the field of DRM/DRR. She holds a Master of Development Policy and Practice of Civil Society from the University of Bradford, United Kingdom. She also holds a Bachelor of Arts in Public Administration from the University of Dar es Salaam.

Her key areas of competences and skills include programming and project management, strategic management programs and operations advocacy, team management, resource mobilization and partnership, budgeting and finance.

Ms. Shoo has a wider experience in overseeing and managing multi-donor humanitarian and development technical projects and operations in the area of Humanitarian Emergencies, Refugee Operation (health, nutrition, reproductive child health), Food Security and Sustainable Livelihood, Climate Change and Adaptation, Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH),Protection, Post-disaster (livelihood), Cash Transfer Programming and Operation, Community Engagement and Accountability as well as Protection, Gender and Inclusion.

name: Dr. Guido A. Uhinga
biography: Dr. Guido Uhinga is a specialist in climate change, geospatial science, and Earth observation. He holds a Ph.D. in Climate Change Studies from Ardhi University, Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, and a Master of Science (MSc) in Geo-Information Science and Earth Observation, specializing in Natural Resources Management, from the International Institute for Geo-Information Science and Earth Observation (ITC), the Netherlands.

Dr. Uhinga has over 20 years of teaching experience in climate change, Geographic Information Systems (GIS), and remote sensing. His expertise encompasses the application of geospatial technologies and Earth observation techniques to climate change research, environmental monitoring, and natural resources management.

He has conducted research in climate change and related fields, contributing to the advancement of scientific knowledge and the application of geospatial technologies to environmental and climate-related challenges. His academic and research interests focus on integrating climate science, geospatial analysis, and Earth observation to support evidence-based decision-making, climate change adaptation, and sustainable natural resources management.
He has contributed to projects and consultancy assignments related to applications of GIS and remote sensing in disaster risk management and climate change in Tanzania and abroad.

name: Hamza A. Farahan
role: Director of Finance and Administration and Co-Founder
biography: Mr. Hamza is a Director of Finance and Administration. He holds a Master of Business Administration (MBA) from Eastern and Southern Africa Management Institute (ESAMI). He also holds an Advanced Diploma in Accountancy from the Institute of Finance Management (IFM), Dar es Salaam. Mr. Hamza has more than 20 years of experience in Financial management and budgeting, financial reporting and analysis. He has completed successfully multiple projects related to finance, accounting and budgeting, finance and accounting systems, and resources mobilization.

name: Mr. Johnston Weston
biography: Johnston Weston is a Certified Project Management Professional ( PMP) and International Disaster Risk Management professional with more than 10 years of experience in disaster preparedness, disaster risk reduction and community resilience programs, disaster preparedness and response trainings , anticipatory action and forecast based financing, cash and voucher programming, integrated early warning early system, humanitarian Operations (emergency response) among others.
Mr. Johnston holds a Master's of Science degree in Disaster Risk Management (MSc DRM) and Bachelor of Science in Housing and Infrastructure Planning (BSc. HIP) from Ardhi University.

He possesses various DRM/DRR skills including but not limited to Leadership, Enhanced Vulnerability Capacity Assessment (EVCA), practical emergency cash emergency(PECT), resource mobilization, result based project management, monitoring and evaluation and reporting , preparedness for effective response assessment ( PER), community engagement and accountability( CEA) and protection gender and inclusion (PGI) coordination, partnerships -especially working with UN Agencies, Red Cross Movement Partners and local communities among others.

name: Mr. Daudi Fufuji
role: GIS, remote sensing and urban planning specialist
biography: Mr. Daudi Fufuji is a Geographic Information Systems (GIS), remote sensing, and urban planning specialist with over 10 years of professional experience. He holds a Master of Science (MSc) in Disaster Risk Management and a Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Housing and Infrastructure Planning, both from Ardhi University, Tanzania.

His areas of expertise include disaster risk assessment and analysis, GIS-based spatial analysis, data management and visualization, project design and implementation, knowledge management and learning, capacity development, and technical assistance. He also has experience in project coordination, stakeholder engagement, collaboration, financial management, and technical communication using digital tools.

Mr. Fufuji has more than five years of experience working with the World Bank in Tanzania as a Disaster Risk Management and GIS Consultant. Through his professional engagements, he has contributed to initiatives involving disaster risk management, geospatial analysis, and evidence-based planning. His work focuses on applying GIS, remote sensing, and spatial planning approaches to support informed decision-making, disaster risk reduction, and sustainable urban development.

name: Mr. Simon M. Machera
role: Software Developer and Data Science Specialist
biography: Simon M. Machera is an Information Technology (IT) specialist, software developer, and trainer with expertise in software engineering, database design, DevOps, data analytics and visualization, and Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML). He holds a Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering and Information Technology and a Master of Science in Data Science, both from the University of Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

Mr. Machera has experience in the design, development, testing, deployment, training, and commissioning of digital platforms, information management systems, and interactive dashboards. His technical expertise includes developing data-driven solutions that support data integration, analysis, visualization, information sharing, and evidence-based decision-making.

He has contributed to several technical projects, including the development of the Geospatial, Statistical, and Research Infrastructure for Industrialisation (GSRII) and the Tanzania Energy Statistics Information System.

Through his work, Mr. Machera applies modern software technologies, data science, and digital innovation to strengthen information systems, improve data accessibility, and support institutional capacity development.

name: Dr. Gervas Michael Kolola
role: Public Administration and Health Systems Specialist
biography: Dr. Gervas Michael Kolola holds a PhD in Development Studies from the International Institute of Social Studies (ISS), Erasmus University Rotterdam, The Netherlands. He also holds a Master of Public Service from the University of Arkansas, USA, and a Master of Philosophy (MPhil) in Public Administration and Organisation Theory from the University of Bergen, Norway.

Dr. Kolola is an accomplished development and public administration specialist with over 20 years of professional experience in university teaching, applied research, consultancy, institutional assessments, monitoring and evaluation, leadership, governance and organisational development. His multidisciplinary expertise spans public-sector management, health systems strengthening, local government administration, human resource management, strategic planning and institutional performance improvement.

Throughout his career, Dr. Kolola has contributed to various development initiatives, research assignments and consultancy programmes aimed at strengthening institutional capacity, improving public-service delivery and enhancing organisational effectiveness. His experience includes supporting government institutions and local authorities through technical advisory services, institutional assessments, capacity development and programme monitoring and evaluation.
